notes:
REF-BM-02: Only a hostname-derived Google favicon is displayed; title, description, preview image, and target-page metadata collection are missing.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are neither detected nor redirected to editing; duplicates can be inserted.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed and stored tags contain no # prefix.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quotes are treated as literal substring characters rather than exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No action marks bookmarks read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No current-filter whole-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed; users cannot choose a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Archive state and default-list exclusion are absent.
REF-BM-27: There is only permanent deletion; reversible archiving is absent.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and saved filter combinations are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
